item.title: Tenjin Matsuri Guide: Osaka's Great River & Fire Festival
item.description: Held every July, Tenjin Matsuri is one of Japan’s three great festivals (with Kyoto’s Gion Matsuri and Tokyo’s Kanda Matsuri) and the biggest party in Osaka. Over a thousand years old, it honours Sugawara no Michizane, the deity of learning, enshrined at Osaka Tenmangu. The festival builds to a spectacular evening climax on July 25: a grand boat procession (funa-togyo) of around a hundred lantern-lit vessels gliding up and down the Okawa River, accompanied by drums, traditional music, and a fireworks finale reflected in the water.
